## Please open this change upstream

Thank you for the contribution. **`triton-hydro/triton` cannot merge pull
requests.** It publishes releases of TRITON: every release commit here is
generated from an upstream release tag, and the chain is assembled elsewhere
and pushed. A merge made on this side would block the next release rather than
travel with it, and it would never reach the people working on the code.

**That is about code, not about problems.** Bugs, usage questions, feature
requests and broken release assets are reported here, in this repository's own
issue tracker — see the bottom of this template.

TRITON is developed at <https://code.ornl.gov/hydro/triton>.
To move this pull request upstream:

1. Keep your branch; nothing is lost.
2. Create an account on <https://code.ornl.gov/hydro/triton> if you can.
3. Fork the upstream project, push your branch there, and open a merge request
   at <https://code.ornl.gov/hydro/triton/-/merge_requests> against the
   development branch.
4. Link the merge request below, then close this pull request.

**If you cannot obtain an account there**, you do not have to. Open an issue on
**this** repository at <https://github.com/triton-hydro/triton/issues>
describing what the change does, and include the patch: produce it with
`git format-patch`, then paste it into the issue inside a fenced code block, or
attach it as a `.txt` or `.zip` file. Link the issue below and close this pull
request.
Maintainers open the corresponding upstream issue when a report needs work in
the development repository.

**Upstream merge request or issue:** <!-- paste the link here -->

---

Reporting a problem rather than proposing a change? Right repository,
wrong form:

- Check the documentation first: <https://triton-ornl.readthedocs.io>
- Bugs, usage questions, feature requests, and problems with a published
  release asset: <https://github.com/triton-hydro/triton/issues>, quoting the
  version tag and the asset name
- **Security-sensitive reports: do not open an issue.**
  <https://github.com/triton-hydro/triton/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md> gives
  how to report one privately, and what to do when no private route is open
  to you.
- Collaboration, institutional, and press enquiries:
  <https://triton.ornl.gov/contact/>

Full policy: <https://github.com/triton-hydro/triton/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md>
